description: This file provides an explanation of the `isExternalLibraryImport` function and related behaviors in TypeScript's module resolution process, including how external modules are handled by the compiler, effects on code emission, and resolution strategies for files within `node_modules` directories.

methods.name: isExternalLibraryImport
methods.description: Boolean returned by node's module resolver indicating whether a target module is inside a `node_modules` directory.
